program_solutions:
(rule!
  (grid-from-fn h w
    (lambda (r c)
      (if (and (= (cell-at g r c) 2)
               (any?
                 (lambda (p)
                   (let ((r0 (first p))
                         (c0 (second p)))
                     (and (>= r0 0) (< r0 (- h 1))
                          (>= c0 0) (< c0 (- w 1))
                          (= (cell-at g r0 c0) 2)
                          (= (cell-at g (+ r0 1) c0) 2)
                          (= (cell-at g r0 (+ c0 1)) 2)
                          (= (cell-at g (+ r0 1) (+ c0 1)) 2))))
                 (list (list r c)
                       (list (- r 1) c)
                       (list r (- c 1))
                       (list (- r 1) (- c 1)))))
          3
          (cell-at g r c)))))
